mcqs.question: How much did the Ministry of Steel allot for green hydrogen pilot projects in the steel sector, and up to which financial year was the allocation specified?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Steel allotted ₹455 crore for green hydrogen pilot projects up to FY 2029–30. The ₹33,660 crore figure relates to the BHAVYA scheme, while ₹397–560 is a green hydrogen cost range rather than the steel-sector pilot allocation.
